title: Certificates of Deposit: grounds for reversing an early withdrawal penalty
content:
## Scope

This policy governs the reversal of an early withdrawal penalty charged on a Certificates of Deposit certificate: when a penalty is credited back, for what reason, in what amount and how many times.

## Policy clauses

1. **Form of a reversal.** A penalty is reversed in full, never in part, as one penalty reversal entry that points to the penalty entry being reversed.
2. **Bank error.** A penalty is reversed with the reason "bank error" when it was assessed contrary to the charter:
   - on a penalty-free withdrawal of a no-penalty certificate after its waiting days;
   - on a withdrawal of credited interest;
   - at a number of penalty days or a rate other than the charter's; or
   - on a basis larger than the principal removed.
3. **Death waiver.** A penalty is reversed with the reason "death waiver" when the bank's estate services confirm that the withdrawal followed the owner's death or adjudicated incompetence.
4. **Once only.** A penalty can be reversed at most once.
5. **Goodwill.** A goodwill reversal of a correctly assessed penalty is outside this policy.

## Retired wording (no longer in force)

The earlier ground for a bank-error reversal "on a grace-period withdrawal", as a ground standing without further condition, is **no longer in force**. It has been superseded by the current basis for penalties charged on grace-period withdrawals. The grounds listed in clause 2 remain in force.

## Grounds at a glance

| Situation of the penalty | Reason for reversal |
|---|---|
| No-penalty certificate, full withdrawal after its waiting days, yet a penalty was charged | Bank error |
| Charged on a withdrawal of credited interest | Bank error |
| Charged at penalty days or a rate other than the charter's | Bank error |
| Charged on a basis larger than the principal the withdrawal removed | Bank error |
| Estate services confirm the withdrawal followed the owner's death or adjudicated incompetence | Death waiver |
| Correctly assessed; the customer asks for it back as a courtesy | Outside this policy |

## Once-only check

Before a reversal is booked, the penalty is checked for an existing reversal entry that points to it. If one exists, the penalty has already been reversed and is not reversed again.

## Points of judgement

**The penalty was 120.00 and only 80.00 of it looks wrong. Is 80.00 reversed?**
No. A penalty is reversed in full, never in part: where a ground applies, the whole 120.00 is reversed.

**A penalty was reversed last month for bank error, and estate services now confirm a death waiver. Is it reversed again?**
No. A penalty can be reversed at most once.
